item.summary: K33 AB (publ) reported group revenue of SEK 261.0 million in the third quarter of 2026, up 35% on the second quarter but down sharply from SEK 933.3 million in the third quarter of 2025. Trading volume at K33 Markets rose 39% quarter on quarter, while global bitcoin spot volumes fell 12.6%. The company reported a profit of SEK 19.9 million, mainly from non-cash reversals of earlier bitcoin impairments, and adjusted EBITDA of -SEK 1.7 million, compared with -SEK 4.6 million in the second quarter.
